SIKAROOF® VERSIJACK® K: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaRoof® VersiJack® K, August 2026, Version 01.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/n/sikaroof-versijackk.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaRoof® VersiJack® K where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (August 2026, Version 01.01).
1.2 Product description.
    - SikaRoof® VersiJack® K is an adjustable pedestal designed to support and level pavers in raised flooring applications. Pedestals are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP), and it uses a screwjack mechanism to provide precise millimetric adjustments from 14 mm to 300 mm, and is designed to receive a self-levelling spacer tab.
    - Creating a raised flooring generates usable space through hiding M&E services, and the void area also provides an insulation layer. Raised floorings also improves surface drainage, while providing waterproofing protection, waterproofing maintenance access and efflorescence elimination.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Screwjack pedestal system for podiums, balconies, roof terraces and areas with hardscape finishes.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.3.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaRoof® VersiJack® K
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: SELF-LEVELLING ADJUSTABLE SCREWJACK PEDESTAL SYSTEM FOR RAISED PAVERS FLOORING
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Certificates and test reports. Singapore Green Building Product (Leader) Cert. No.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - ASTM D695-15: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Compressive strength (p.3).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Self-levelling capabilities
    - Conceal M&E services
    - Promotes surface drainage
    - Better thermal insulation
    - Access to waterproofing membrane
    - Eliminates efflorescence
    - Recyclable components
    - Resistant to biological attack by moulds and algae
    - Chemically resistant to acids, alkalis, oils and soil chemicals
    - Operates within a wide service temperature range
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance and colour: Black circular screwjack pedestal
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Diameter: Base Diameter; 205 mm
    - Compressive strength: 11 kN (ASTM D695-15)
2.7 Height. Height Range
    | K1 | K2 | K3 |
    | 14 mm – 25 mm | 25 mm – 46 mm | 43 mm – 70 mm |
    | K4 | K5 | K3 |
    | 69 mm – 118 mm | 116 mm – 210 mm | 205 mm – 300 mm |
2.8 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Shelf life: No expiration date if the product is stored in accordance to the storage conditions as stated in this Product Data Sheet.
    - Storage conditions: Product must be stored in their original packing, and under cool and dry conditions. The product must be protected from direct sunlight, rain, snow and ice, and any other elements.
2.9 Packaging. SikaRoof® VersiJack®
    | K1 | K2 | K3 |
    | K4 | K5 | K6 |
    | Refer to pricelist |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (August 2026, Version 01.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate preparation. Clean and sound surface shall have at least a wood float finish. All holes, joints, and cracks and honeycombs in concrete or masonry surfaces shall be filled with an approved grout and allowed to cure. High spots in concrete or masonry surfaces shall be cut off or ground down to prevent damage/puncture to the pedestal base.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (August 2026, Version 01.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application. SikaRoof® VersiJack® K shall be loosely laid without any mechanical fixing either on top of the waterproofing membrane or on top of the concrete surface. For a bonded application, the pedestal may be adhered to the substrate with an approved adhesive. The first paver shall be installed to the correct elevation before using a levelling device to serve as a reference. Subsequent pavers shall be installed and checked to ensure consistent and correct elevation, till a sturdy and rigid raised flooring is obtained, free of rattling, squeaking or other noises.
4.3 Limitations and important considerations.
    - SikaRoof® VersiJack® K is not resistant to permanent weathering and UV exposure.
    For more information, please contact Sika Sales Personnel.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (August 2026, Version 01.01) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Compressive strength: 11 kN (ASTM D695-15)
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaRoof® VersiJack® K, August 2026, Version 01.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/n/sikaroof-versijackk.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it. For safe use follow the instructions given in the product data sheet. Based on our current knowledge, this product does not contain SVHC (substances of very high concern) as listed in Annex XIV of the REACH regulation or on the candidate list published by the European Chemicals Agency in concentrations above 0,1 % (w/w).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
